theme.title: Jordan in the Finals
theme.subtitle: Chicago Bulls, 1991–98
theme.recap: Michael Jordan's Finals nights, from 13 straight makes in 1991 to the flu game and the last shot in Utah.

questions.prompt: How many points did Michael Jordan score in Game 6 of the 1998 Finals, the night of his title-winning last shot?
questions.note: 45, capped by the game-winner over Bryon Russell.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Jordan scored 45 points, and hit a memorable game-winning shot over Jazz forward Bryon Russell

funFacts.text: Scottie Pippen aggravated his back injury on the opening dunk of the title clincher.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: aggravated his injury when he dunked the opening basket of the game

funFacts.text: Karl Malone led Utah with 31 points but could not prevent Chicago's final title.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Pts: Karl Malone 31

funFacts.text: Jordan stripped the ball from Malone before setting up his winning jumper over Bryon Russell.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: When John Stockton passed the ball to Karl Malone, Jordan stole the ball away

questions.prompt: In Game 2 of the 1991 Finals, Michael Jordan made how many shots in a row?

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Jordan would hit his next 13 shots in compensation

funFacts.text: Phil Jackson put Scottie Pippen on Magic Johnson as the key defensive adjustment.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: The biggest decision of the game was putting Scottie Pippen on Magic Johnson

funFacts.text: The Lakers had won the opener in Chicago before the Bulls responded in Game 2.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Game 1  | June 2  | Los Angeles Lakers  | 93–91 (1–0)  | Chicago Bulls

funFacts.text: Marv Albert's call of Jordan's midair, switch-handed layup became one of his signature broadcasts.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: one of Albert's most iconic calls

questions.prompt: What did Michael Jordan average per game in the 1993 Finals against Phoenix, a Finals record?
questions.context: 1993 NBA Finals · six games vs Phoenix

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: averaged a Finals-record 41.0 PPG during the six-game series

funFacts.text: The Suns traded Jeff Hornacek, Tim Perry and Andrew Lang to Philadelphia for Charles Barkley.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: acquiring Charles Barkley from the Philadelphia 76ers in exchange for Jeff Hornacek, Tim Perry, and Andrew Lang

funFacts.text: Phoenix forced a rare triple-overtime Game 3, then won it at Chicago Stadium.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: The Phoenix Suns won Game 3 in triple overtime, 129–121

funFacts.text: Scottie Pippen also filled the box score with over nine rebounds and seven assists per game.

questions.prompt: Sick before Game 5 of the 1997 Finals, how many points did Michael Jordan score in the "Flu Game"?

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Jordan played 44 minutes, finishing the game with 38 points, 7 rebounds, 5 assists, 3 steals and 1 block.

funFacts.text: Jordan awoke in the early morning with severe stomach symptoms before Game 5.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Jordan woke up and began to experience vomiting and diarrhea

funFacts.text: He later said he believed food poisoning from a pizza caused the illness.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Jordan eventually claimed it was food poisoning in the 2020 docuseries The Last Dance

funFacts.text: At the final buzzer, an exhausted Jordan collapsed into teammate Scottie Pippen's arms.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Jordan collapsed into Scottie Pippen's arms

questions.prompt: The 1998 Finals drew the highest Nielsen TV rating in NBA history. What was it?

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: garnered the highest Nielsen TV ratings in NBA history at 18.7

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: even surpassed the Nielsen ratings for the 1998 World Series

funFacts.text: Phil Jackson had called the Bulls' farewell campaign 'The Last Dance' before the season began.

source.quote: Phil Jackson wrote on the chalk board and named the season "The Last Dance"
